# mcrl user

[Command reference](README.md)

Manage organization members.

```text
Aliases:
  user, users
```

| Subcommand | Description |
|---|---|
| [`user list`](#mcrl-user-list) | List organization members |
| [`user remove`](#mcrl-user-remove) | Remove a member from the organization |

## mcrl user list

List organization members.

```text
Usage:
  mcrl user list

Aliases:
  list, ls

List organization members.

API: GET /api/v0/users
API key permission: Read

Examples:
  mcrl user list
  mcrl user list --jq '.[] | select(.isMFAEnabled | not) | .email'
```

## mcrl user remove

Remove a member from the organization.

```text
Usage:
  mcrl user remove <user>

Aliases:
  remove, rm, delete

Remove a member from the organization. The user is given by ID, email or screen name.

API: DELETE /api/v0/users/<id>
API key permission: Read, Write

Examples:
  mcrl user remove alice@example.com
  mcrl user remove alice --yes
```
